Protocol text: Easy nLC 1000 connected to a Q Exactive HF; PRIDE instrument field agrees. RAW headers not inspected.
Protocol: MS/MS using higher-energy collision induced dissociation (HCD).
Protocol: pan HLA class I antibody W6/32 coupled to AminoLink plus beads.
Protocol: mono-allelic B721.221 cells expressing HLA-A*02:01. Patient samples are HLA-A2+ per paper but allele-level typing not given, so not available.

claims.evidence: Protocol: heavy isotope labelled peptide YI(13C6,15N)MSDSNYV spiked at 200 pg; this RAW is by name the standard run.

limitations: Run-to-sample mapping is undecodable: protocol names two patient samples (patients 1 and 3) but H222724PBMC.raw and H224278.raw cannot be assigned to patient 1 or 3 without a mapping; source names are neutral and the file names are kept only as identifiers. The 'PBMC' in a file name was not used to infer organism part.
Organism part, age, sex and individual are not stated per sample (patient sample details are in supplementary tables not deposited); set to not available. Cell type of patient cells not available.

B721.221 identity (Cellosaurus LCL 721.221, CVCL_6263) was not written as characteristics[cell line]/[cellosaurus accession] columns because the cell-lines template was not declared (only 1 of 4 rows is a cell line and the cell-line columns permit no 'not applicable'); the cell line name is in the source name and cell type is B cell.

The heavy peptide standard run has mhc protein complex and immunopeptidome enrichment method filled with the required template values only because these columns are required without reserved words; they do not describe the standard. Whether Isotpoiclabelledpeptide.raw is a standard-only run is inferred from its file name and the protocol.
The heavy peptide spike-in (200 pg) applies to all samples but was not encoded in characteristics[spiked compound].

Tolerances not available: no search was done. RAW headers were not read; instrument from protocol text only. Biological replicate set to 1 for each distinct source (no replicate structure known). Deposited PXD043908_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv was not consulted.
Exact m/z targets, retention time window (27-31 min) and fragmentation resolution (15,000) are described in the protocol but have no required SDRF column used here.

SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): the heavy-peptide standard row carries filler values for the immunopeptidomics-required MHC and enrichment columns (a synthetic peptide was not immunopurified), and AML patient 1/3 cannot be mapped to the two patient RAW files.
